Neobric IT Solutions Pvt Ltd. Senior Software Engineer

Hyderabad, India May 2024 - June 2026

❖ Led the decomposition of a monolithic NestJS application into two independent

microservices, collaborating with a team of 5–10 developers to deﬁne service boundaries, migrate APIs, separate infrastructure components, and optimize system architecture.

❖ I have been working on REST api/s using Nestjs for Kornferry. Created a node npm package for Amqp protocol which provides auto reconnection to AWS RabbitMQ instance via secret manager and app conﬁg, also provisions connection and channel pooling with customisable pools and publishing and subscribing to queues and exchanges.

❖ Designed and developed a Notiﬁcation Platform using NestJS, RabbitMQ, PostgreSQL, Redis,

and Novu, including Notiﬁcation API and Worker Services for real-time enterprise notiﬁcations.

❖ Architected and implemented shared internal npm packages for RabbitMQ messaging,

notiﬁcation integrations, logging, and Redis caching; published reusable frameworks to JFrog Artifactory and consumed across services.

❖ Designed PostgreSQL schemas and ETL workﬂows using Apache NiFi, RabbitMQ, for

notiﬁcation subscriber, subscription, topic, audit, and data management supporting both historical and incremental data loads.

❖ Optimized slow APIs and database workloads through Query refactoring, CTE optimization, Join optimization, Index tuning, Composite index design, Execution plan analysis and Redis caching strategies.

❖ Designed and implemented an AI-powered document intelligence module using NestJS, AWS Bedrock, RAG, MongoDB Vector Search, and React, enabling natural language search and contextual question-answering across enterprise documents.

❖ Built scalable document ingestion pipelines using Apache NiFi, Amazon S3, RabbitMQ

(Amazon MQ), and asynchronous workers for document extraction, chunking, metadata enrichment, embedding generation, and vector indexing.

❖ Integrated LLM capabilities through AWS Bedrock, leveraging retrieval-augmented generation

(RAG) patterns, semantic search, prompt engineering, and context-aware response generation to improve answer accuracy and reduce hallucinations.

❖ Leveraged Cursor IDE, Claude, GitHub Copilot, and agentic AI workﬂows for code analysis, performance optimization, cacheability assessments, code generation, and engineering productivity improvements.

❖ Responsibilities:

➢ Collect and understand the requirements of features from the Client, team leads and

technical architects.

➢ Develop REST APIs related to the application and improve performance through query tuning, indexing strategies, Redis caching, and event-driven processing patterns.

➢ Mentored junior developers, conducted architecture reviews and PR reviews,

contributed to sprint planning and estimations, and authored technical documentation for platform components and integrations. .

➢ Write technical documentation for the product and the features.

➢ Contributed to project planning, story creation, and timeline estimations.

❖ Technologies: Microservices, Node.js, NestJS, TypeScript, JavaScript, REST APIs, RabbitMQ,
